fusions.name: Scattered Wisps
fusions.desc: Looses 3 drifting lights at once, spread apart, out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 fire damage with a 10% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Brand-Tail Lash
fusions.desc: A lash of your burning tail that deals 11 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hot to Handle
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailing Embers
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
